subject: Vendor profile update: bank change + warehouse address confirmation
messages:
From: Victor Ramos <ops@blueharborlogistics.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: vendor-portal@blueharborlogistics.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor profile update – Blue Harbor Logistics (Vendor ID: VND-8842)

Hi Soojin,

We need to update our vendor record with Redwood. Effective July 15 we'd like to switch the primary payout account and provide an updated warehouse shipping address. Details below:

- Vendor ID: VND-8842
- New payout bank: Blue Harbor Commercial Bank, Account ending **4321**, Routing 122000046
- New remittance address / warehouse: 1101 Harbor Way, Building B, Suite 210, Tacoma, WA 98402
- AP contact: Victor Ramos — ops@blueharborlogistics.com — +1 (206) 555-0192

Attached: bank letter (bank-issued confirmation), updated W-9.

Please confirm the steps you need from our side to get the change into effect and whether Redwood will perform an ACH micro-deposit verification. Also confirm which open POs (if any) will be impacted and whether we should expect any holds.

Thanks,
Victor Ramos
Operations Manager
Blue Harbor Logistics
attachments: blueharbor_bank_letter_20270629.pdf (pdf), blueharbor_w9_20270629.pdf (pdf)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Victor Ramos <ops@blueharborlogistics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor profile update – Blue Harbor Logistics (Vendor ID: VND-8842)

Hi Victor — thanks for the heads up and for sending the documents. I’ve looped in Finance (Laura) and our vendor-ops engineer (Dev) to coordinate the portal and payments side. Next steps from Redwood:

1) Finance will perform standard validation of the bank letter + W-9; if everything checks we will schedule the payout account swap and a micro-deposit verification.
2) Dev will create a portal change request to update the remittance bank details and the warehouse shipping address so new POs route correctly.
3) We’ll place a soft hold on new payments to the old account until micro-deposit verification completes. Existing POs with pending invoices will be evaluated case-by-case; Laura will confirm.

Can you please confirm:
- That the bank letter is on bank letterhead and includes the full account number (not masked) or a statement that the bank can provide a verification call if needed.
- Whether the EIN/TIN on the new W-9 is the same as your existing record (VND-8842) or if it changed.

Tentative timeline: if Finance approves by July 7, we can schedule the switch for July 15. If anything looks off we’ll escalate.

Thanks — I’ll follow up once Finance posts their verification.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0124
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 12:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor profile update – Blue Harbor Logistics (Vendor ID: VND-8842)

Thanks — quick ops note on the portal/update process so expectations are clear:

- I will open a Vendor Portal change ticket (JIRA-SUP-1123) and attach Blue Harbor’s new bank letter + W-9.
- Technical steps: we update the payment_instruments table for vendor VND-8842 to add the new ACH entry (meta: bank_name, acct_last4=4321, routing=122000046) and mark previous primary as historical.
- We will set the new instrument to UNVERIFIED and trigger a micro-deposit. Finance (Laura) must mark the document set as APPROVED before we schedule the micro-deposit to avoid partial payments.
- Address update: warehouse shipping address will be added to vendor.ship_to list and mapped to PO routing rules (warehouse address has different freight terms; confirm whether Blue Harbor wants carrier-prepaid).

Risks / questions:
- If the EIN on the W-9 changed, legal needs to approve — that can add 3–5 business days.
- If Victor can confirm that the bank will accept a verification call, that speeds up the finance signoff.

I’ll update JIRA-SUP-1123 with the step-by-step checklist and a link to the hubspot deal. Dev
